product.description: Stropi este un avion utilitar care visează să participe la cel mai mare raliu aerian din istorie. Deși fizicul nu îi prea permite și – în plus – îi este frică de înălțime, Stropi reușește, cu ajutorul Șefului și cu un dram de noroc, să se califice în marea finală. # Disney Avioane Storybook Set (Book + CD) by Litera

## Bring Aviation Adventure Home with Disney!

Dive into the thrilling world of aerial races and friendship with this Disney story set, **Disney Avioane (Airplanes)**. Perfect for young readers and aspiring aviation enthusiasts, this bilingual learning package combines an engaging storybook with a complementary CD to enhance the reading experience. Get ready for an exciting tale of determination, speed, and overcoming fear!

*(Currently priced at 8.75, marked down from 34.99)*

## Story Synopsis: The Great Air Race

The adventure centers around Stropi, a resourceful utility plane who dreams of participating in the biggest air rally in history. Despite his physical limitations and deep-seated fear of heights, Stropi manages to qualify for the grand finale with the help of Èef and a great deal of luck.

But this victory sparks rivalry! The competitive spirit and speed Stropi demonstrates upset the plans of Ripslinger, the current champion. Ripslinger attempts every method imaginable to thwart Stropi's dream, promising a thrilling race against time and rivals. Children will enjoy following the plot as determination triumphs over sabotage in this heartwarming tale.

## Why Choose This Disney Story Collection?

This educational package is designed not only for entertainment but also to foster early literacy and an interest in STEM subjects through storytelling.

*   **Engaging Narrative:** The story features fast-paced action, character development (Stropi, Ripslinger), and themes of perseverance.
*   **Multi-Sensory Learning:** Includes both a physical book format and a CD component for immersive listening and readingâideal for various learning styles.
*   **High Quality Fun:** Published by Litera, this Disney collection ensures quality content that captures the imagination of children in the "Copii" category.

### Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

**What is the primary focus of the story?**
The story follows Stropi, a utility plane who competes in a major air rally against the reigning champion, Ripslinger. It teaches themes of sportsmanship and perseverance.

**Is this set suitable for pre-readers?**
While it includes a book and CD, the narrative suggests it is best suited for early readers or those learning to read through accompanying audio content.
